9.reason: Group 9 is Limits/Performance: each case sends 1000 messages of DATALEN as fast as the peer will take them and the suite marks the case FAILED when the agent cannot sustain the rate, so a failure here is a rate and not a protocol fault. What is listed is the eight the recorded run reported as failures; whether the 1024-byte cases (9.1.1, 9.2.1) hold is one of the things the next recorded run has to decide, because the previous entry's claim that they pass was not what the report said. The inbound ring holds 64 messages and the Node main thread drains it, so a burst outruns the consumer. It moves only when the engine thread's drain does, and a rate the pinned build cannot hold is a fact about the build rather than something to argue away in the baseline.
